title: Make each request carry its own response type
symptom: suspendDelivery waited for StopTempRateRequest's opcode instead of StopTempRateResponse, so the reply was dropped and every user suspend with a running temp basal stalled 30 s (delivery continued at profile rate) before SuspendPumping went out.
log_signature: ^Not handler for message - data: [0-9a-f]{4}a7[0-9a-f]* characteristic: 7B83FFFC
fixed_marker_regex: ^Failed to stop temp rate before suspending - Status: -?\d+$
notes: Opcode -89 = 0xa7 at byte index 2 of the notification. Full pattern: 'Suspend Insulin Delivery...' -> Not handler (a7) -> ~30 s -> 'Timeout hit, no response from pump...' -> suspend. PR #318 (merge bd852e397, same day) adds the outcome log for the stop; the fixed_marker line only appears when the stop is refused. Positive evidence post-fix: 'Current temp basal cancelled!' logged from function suspendDelivery(completion:) (check the prefix's func name) within ~1 s of 'Suspend Insulin Delivery...'. Per the PR, every 'Not handler for message' in the then-reported logs was this opcode. | Analyzer: restricted to the CONTROL characteristic (7B83FFFC); opcode 0xa7 on CURRENT_STATUS (7B83FFF6) is LocalizationResponse, a different message.
strength_basis: opcode 0xa7 gets a handler in the fix

title: Fix temp basal rate rounding to never exceed requested rate
symptom: Temp basal percent was rounded to nearest, so the enacted/reported rate could exceed the requested rate by up to 0.5% of the scheduled basal; Trio drops temp-basal records above maxBasal.
log_signature: Reported temp basal dose rate > requested rate ('Setting temp basal at X U/hr for Ns' < rate reported to Trio). Post-fix the reported/enacted rate is always <= the request (pump lower is intended).
notes: Algorithm (main, 30396d3): r = floor_to_0.01(request); p = clamp(round(r/baseline*100), 0, 250); rate = floor_to_0.01(baseline*p/100); while rate > r: p -= 1. Reported dose value == rate. baseline = app schedule on main; pump's profileBasalRate on dev (#500). | Analyzer link (observed, 2026-10-04): Trio's logged temp-basal rate exceeding TandemKit's set rate by <= one percent step occurs only on builds without this fix.

symptom: Responses split over several BLE notifications failed: continuation packets were matched on byte 2 (cargo, not opcode) and dropped as unhandled, and a 3-byte final packet was rejected, so the write timed out (affects e.g. Jpake4KeyConfirmationResponse and other >15-byte responses at small MTU).

Post-fix 'Waiting for more data...' is still logged but from peripheral(_:didUpdateValueFor:error:) and followed by 'Received message:'. Severity depends on negotiated MTU; at iOS's usual large MTU most responses are single-packet.
